found.quote: Never enter personal data, unpublished research, your own or anyone else’s work, or other sensitive or confidential information into a tool that is not University-approved.
found.anchor: Protect information and use approved tools.

unsure.quote: Verify its outputs using reliable original sources (such as professional websites, academic books and journal articles) and cite those sources as your evidence - not the GenAI tool.
